description: This file contains database migration functions and related logic for the Focalboard project, including handling of block IDs, category board deduplication, and collation fixes.

methods.name: getBlocksWithSameID
methods.description: Retrieves blocks with duplicate IDs from the database.

methods.name: RunUniqueIDsMigration
methods.description: Performs migration to ensure all blocks have unique IDs.

methods.name: RunCategoryUUIDIDMigration
methods.description: Performs migration to derive categories from boards and memberships.

methods.name: RunFixCollationsAndCharsetsMigration
methods.description: Fixes table collation and charset mismatches for MySQL.

methods.name: getFocalBoardTableNames
methods.description: Fetches all FocalBoard-related table names in the database.

methods.name: getCollationAndCharset
methods.description: Retrieves collation and charset info for a specific table.

methods.name: RunDeDuplicateCategoryBoardsMigration
methods.description: Deduplicates entries in category_boards table, supports multiple DB types.

methods.name: doesDuplicateCategoryBoardsExist
methods.description: Checks if duplicate category_board entries exist.
